police.speaker: Detective Morris
police.text: We will verify the parcel collection signature and keep its source intact. A lead is not a rescue; we cannot assume Victor stayed there.

signal.speaker: David
signal.text: I will check the technical trail behind the parcel collection signature. Amara, tell me what the records cannot explain.

alone.speaker: David
alone.text: I am following the parcel collection signature without police backup. Amara has my location; I am not going to turn this into a contest with Victor.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: The next lead is the parcel collection signature. We need its original source before Victor moves again.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: My money or Ethan is his threat, not a debt I owe.
